$comment: The load guard (spec/guard.md). Replay the steps in order with a fresh guard per scenario: run = begin a sync run, start/finish = a request (status 0: no answer), check = must answer `expected` ({ok: true} or {ok: false, reasons sorted, until: seconds or null}).

limits.$comment: The load guard's limits (spec/guard.md). Normative: a client of this project never exceeds them, whatever a target's plan says. Counted per provider account, across restarts.

cases.name: one_at_a_time
cases.why: Busy while a request is out; at least pause_s.min after the last ended.

cases.name: per_run
cases.why: At most per_run requests in one sync run; a new run may go on.

cases.name: per_hour_rolling
cases.why: The last 60 minutes, rolling: the oldest request leaving the window frees one place.

cases.name: per_day_rolling
cases.why: The last 24 hours, rolling, history included.

cases.name: backoff
cases.why: After 429, 5xx or no answer: 60 s, doubled each time in a row; a good answer starts again at 60 s.

cases.name: backoff_cap
cases.why: The backoff never grows past max_s.

cases.name: retry_after
cases.why: Retry-After holds when it is longer than the backoff, even past the hour; a shorter one doesn't shorten the backoff; on a good answer it means nothing.

cases.name: per_account
cases.why: Counts and pauses are kept per provider account.
